origin.origins_backgrounds_two.greenwitc: Greenwitches waxay leeyihiin karti dabiici ah oo ay wax ku ubaxsan karaan.

origin.origins_backgrounds_two.deep_mine: Marka ay sii qoto-dheeraanayaan waxay noqonaysaa weel aad u awood badan oo qodista.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.miner.des: Ka hoos shaqaynta Macdanta Master-ka ayaa baray inay si dhakhso ah wax u qotaan ama looga tago boodhka dhagaxa.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.blacksmit: Helitaanka hubka saxda ah ee saxda ah ayaa aad uga muhimsan inta ay dadka qaar garanayaan.

origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.name: Tababare Cook
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.desc: Waxa laga yaabaa inaanay noqon Madaxa Kuug, laakiin kuma sumayn doonaan. Shil.

origin.origins_backgrounds_two.bounty_hu: Haddii aad u baahan tahay caddaynta dhimashada, waxay ku siin doonaan.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.pickpocke: Waxa aad u badantahay in aad ku xafido alaabtaada qaaliga ah agtooda.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.butcher.d: Waxay yaqaaniin sida loo gooyo iyada oo aan wax hilib ah la lumin.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.alchemist: Fidaa awoodda marka la cabbo maandooriyaha.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.street_ra: Markay ku soo koreen waddooyinka, waxay barteen inay calooshooda birta u bireeyaan.
Weildida faas waxay noqotay dabeecadda labaad ee Woodsmen.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.angler.de: Haddi laga yimaado doon ama xeebta, Angler ayaa had iyo jeer helaya qabashada ugu fiican.
